name: splatoon-farmers
description: Board-resident ESP32-S3 material farming controller with a Web Serial console.

scripts.test: npm run test:firmware && npm run test:web
scripts.test:firmware: c++ -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -pedantic -I firmware/include firmware/src/MacroEngine.cpp firmware/src/BuiltinMacroLibrary.cpp firmware/src/builtins/TempuraNestWeaponFarm.cpp firmware/src/builtins/AnlingNestMoneyFarm.cpp firmware/src/builtins/WeaponDismantle.cpp firmware/src/builtins/ConnectController.cpp tests/firmware/test_macro_engine.cpp -o /tmp/splatoon-farmers-macro-test && /tmp/splatoon-farmers-macro-test
